name: RealFi
description: IOG-backed stablecoin platform routing on-chain deposits into real-world fixed-income assets such as money market funds and corporate bonds. Depositors mint a base stablecoin and can stake it for a yield-bearing token.
notes: Token tickers are taken from the live realfi.co homepage (USDrf / sUSDrf); third-party press consistently calls them USDr / sUSDr, and the discrepancy is unresolved. Not yet on mainnet as of research (testnet 'Pioneer Season'; mainnet stated for 2026-10-01), and the site excludes US/EU/UK/Hong Kong users. Distinct from the defunct realfi.info wallet dashboard and from the Cardano RealFi Consortium, which share the name.
